name: L. A. Bull
role: Buffalo doctor visiting the Bad Lands
mentions: …Wm. Jones, 777 ranch; W. W. Sewel, S. E. Sewel, Wm. Rowe, Thomas McGregor, Elkhorn ranch; Dr. and Mrs. L. A. Bull, Buffalo, N. Y. Miss Wadsworth,
Dr. and Mrs. Bull, of Buffalo, N. Y. are here visiting the Bad Lands. They will go on west this evening.
